_schema.hp: Hit points of THIS gear layer. When depleted the unit 'breaks gear' and becomes downgrade_to (overflow damage carries over).
_schema.armor_pct: Fraction of incoming damage removed before armor_pen is applied.
_schema.threat: Lives lost if the unit reaches the base.
_schema.flags: flying | invisible | mini_boss | boss | structure | airdrop | mounted | cart | swift | no_downgrade_reward
_schema.abilities: Data-driven behaviours resolved by EnemyAbilities (see scripts/enemies/enemy_abilities.gd).
_schema.naming: Original gear-progression tiers (not Bloons terminology). 'Chungie' is community slang for an under-geared player.

enemies.name: Chungie
enemies.codex: A fresh player in nothing but a wooden sword. Individually harmless; Cindercrest sends them in floods.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Baseline fodder that teaches targeting and economy.

enemies.name: Iron Chungie
enemies.codex: Full iron. When the plates crack, a plain Chungie keeps running underneath.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Introduces the gear-break layer mechanic and armor reduction.

enemies.name: Diamond Chungie
enemies.codex: Diamond-clad. Rewards armor-piercing damage.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Mid-tier tank that pressures single-target DPS.

enemies.name: Enchanted Chungie
enemies.codex: Protection and Mending glint on every piece. Slowly repairs its gear while walking.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Regen punishes chip damage; burst and focus fire counter it.

enemies.name: Netherite Chungie
enemies.codex: Cindercrest can put thousands of players in netherite. This is what that looks like.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Heavy armor wall; explosives and armor penetration shine.

enemies.name: Cindercrest Warrior
enemies.codex: An old player who has fought since the Mafia days. Mace, enchanted netherite, and a grudge against new players.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Elite PvP unit; fast and heavily armored, doubles as a leak punisher.

enemies.name: Cindercrest Commander
enemies.codex: Carries the Cindercrest banner. Nearby soldiers march faster and hold formation.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Priority target that buffs the wave around it.

enemies.name: Elytra Glider
enemies.codex: Rocket-boosted elytra flight over the walls. Ground traps and melee cannot touch it.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Forces anti-air / ranged coverage.

enemies.name: Archer
enemies.codex: Pins down defenders with Power-enchanted volleys.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Reduces tower fire rate; rewards killing it first.

enemies.name: Potion Brewer
enemies.codex: Brews Regeneration for the column and shatters Slowness on whoever kills it.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Support unit; positional decision about when to kill it.

enemies.name: TNT Runner
enemies.codex: Runs a primed TNT block at the gate. Killing it inside a column blows up its friends.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Risk/reward: huge leak damage, but a crowd-control opportunity.

enemies.name: Speedster
enemies.codex: Swiftness II and golden boots. Sprints past sleepy towers.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Tests targeting modes (first/last) and slows.

enemies.name: Invisible Player
enemies.codex: An Invisible Mafia habit that never died: potions of invisibility and a knife in the dark.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Requires detection (Spepticle, Leo, Spoke) to target.

enemies.name: Builder
enemies.codex: Far Lands taught everyone: Builders matter. Drops cobblestone walls that soak up arrows.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Creates obstacles that absorb tower fire until destroyed.

enemies.name: Cobblestone Wall
enemies.codex: A hastily placed cobblestone wall.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Obstruction entity.

enemies.name: Shield Bearer
enemies.codex: Walks point with a raised shield. Arrows skip off; TNT does not.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Tank that favours explosives and melee over projectiles.

enemies.name: Assassin
enemies.codex: Cindercrest's contract killers stun anything they pass.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Disables towers; punishes clustering near the path.

enemies.name: Horse Rider
enemies.codex: Cavalry. Shoot the horse and the rider has to walk.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Fast two-stage target.

enemies.name: Dismounted Rider
enemies.codex: Lost the horse.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Second stage of the rider.

enemies.name: Minecart Rider
enemies.codex: Rides the supply rails straight through the choke points.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Fast, lane-locked target immune to lateral knockback.

enemies.name: TNT Minecart
enemies.codex: Theo's favourite tool, turned against the fort. Explodes at the gate or when destroyed.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Must be killed early and away from the column.

enemies.name: Totem Carrier
enemies.codex: A Totem of Undying in the off-hand. Dies twice.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Effective HP spike; rewards burst that overkills.

enemies.name: Wither
enemies.codex: Withers infested spawn during the Kings era; Cindercrest breeds them for sieges. Skulls stun defenders.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Flying siege boss that disables towers.

enemies.name: Paratrooper
enemies.codex: Slow Falling potions and a Redstone Blimp: the trick that took Fort Feather.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Spawns deep in the path, bypassing early defences.

enemies.name: Royal Defector
enemies.codex: Parrot's own Royal Army, persuaded by Saparata to turn.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Boss phase 5 reinforcements.

enemies.name: Pearl Runner
enemies.codex: Ender pearls forward every few seconds.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Teleport skips tower windows.

enemies.name: ShoeBilly_
enemies.codex: The assassin who emptied Skymore. His helmet cracks under enough pressure — Wemmbu proved it.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Phase-2 mini-boss; armor-break transition.

enemies.name: ShoeBilly_ (Helmet Broken)
enemies.codex: Retreating faster now that the helmet is gone.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Second stage: faster, weaker.

enemies.name: Saparata
enemies.codex: Leader of Cindercrest. Ruthless, persistent, and certain the old players deserve the server.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Final boss of Fort Feather; phases scripted by SaparataEncounter.

enemies.name: Redstone Blimp
enemies.codex: Cindercrest's airship. It carried the paratroopers that broke Fort Feather.
enemies.gameplay_reason: Destructible event entity; shooting it down stops the drops.
